summary: Heroes of Might and Magic entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Heroes of Might and Magic III
entries.definitive_edition: Heroes of Might and Magic III Complete on GOG

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GOG Complete with documented compatibility/HD-mod setup

primary.version: Heroes of Might and Magic III Complete on GOG
primary.why: GOG's Complete edition includes the base game plus Armageddon's Blade and The Shadow of Death, along with modern compatibility/preservation work. The Steam HD Edition is visually updated but based only on the original Restoration of Erathia content.
primary.how_to_play: Use Heroes of Might and Magic III Complete on GOG for the main route. Record GOG build/wrapper, resolution or HD mod use, expansion campaign, random-map/hotseat settings, and multiplayer setup if relevant.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Restoration of Erathia retail route.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical route, but incomplete without expansions and less convenient than GOG Complete.

all_releases.platform: Armageddon's Blade / The Shadow of Death expansions
all_releases.fidelity: Expansion content included in the Complete route.
all_releases.reason: primary: required for complete Heroes III archive coverage.

all_releases.platform: GOG Heroes of Might and Magic III Complete
all_releases.fidelity: Complete digital route with modern compatibility/preservation updates.

all_releases.platform: Heroes of Might and Magic III HD Edition
all_releases.fidelity: HD remaster based on the original 1999 Restoration of Erathia game.
all_releases.reason: skip: lacks the Complete edition expansion coverage.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The HD Edition is cleaner visually but lacks expansion coverage; GOG Complete is the completeness route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Prefer GOG Complete over HD Edition when expansion completeness matters. Document any HD mod/community patch use separately.

entries.title: Heroes of Might and Magic IV
entries.definitive_edition: Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Complete on GOG

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GOG Complete build with documented compatibility settings

primary.version: Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Complete on GOG
primary.why: The GOG Complete route includes the base game plus The Gathering Storm and Winds of War expansions, is DRM-free, and is maintained for modern Windows. The original Windows/Mac releases remain useful history but are less convenient and less complete.
primary.how_to_play: Use Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Complete from GOG. Record GOG build, expansion/campaign, resolution/wrapper settings, AI difficulty, map size, multiplayer/hotseat setup, and any fan patches or compatibility changes.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for version-history or Mac-port documentation.
secondary.why: GOG Complete is the better current completeness and compatibility route.

all_releases.reason: skip: incomplete without expansions and less practical than GOG Complete.

all_releases.platform: The Gathering Storm / Winds of War expansions
all_releases.fidelity: Expansion campaigns and content included in Complete.
all_releases.reason: primary: required for content-complete archive coverage.

all_releases.platform: GOG Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Complete
all_releases.fidelity: Complete compilation and DRM-free current Windows route maintained through GOG Preservation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original discs are historically exact, but GOG Complete is the best complete and maintainable archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document fan patches or wrapper changes separately from the GOG baseline.

entries.title: Heroes of Might and Magic II
entries.definitive_edition: Heroes of Might and Magic II: Gold on GOG, with executable/engine state documented

emulation.notes: Use GOG Gold for assets; label whether playing original executable or fheroes2.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original executable from Gold route, or fheroes2 with version documented

primary.version: Heroes of Might and Magic II: Gold on GOG
primary.why: GOG's Gold route includes the base game and The Price of Loyalty expansion, making it the practical complete route. Fheroes2 is an active open-source engine recreation and should be labeled if used because it improves/changes behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Heroes of Might and Magic II: Gold from GOG for the main route. Record GOG build, DOS/Windows executable or fheroes2 engine, expansion/campaign, map size, AI difficulty, multiplayer/hotseat state, and any fan patches.

secondary.exclusive_content: Open-source engine recreation with modern resolution, fixes, and AI improvements
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the modern engine route.
secondary.why: It requires labeling because it is not the original executable.

all_releases.platform: Heroes of Might and Magic II: Gold
all_releases.fidelity: Base game plus The Price of Loyalty expansion.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete current route through GOG.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern open-source engine route with improvements and behavior changes.
all_releases.reason: secondary: convenience/fix route, not the original executable.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: GOG Gold is complete, but fheroes2 and original executables differ and must be labeled.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record fheroes2 use separately from original executable play.

entries.title: Heroes of Might and Magic: A Strategic Quest
entries.definitive_edition: GOG/current PC route with exact executable and compatibility state documented

emulation.notes: Use GOG/owned PC release for primary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC executable with exact DOSBox/Windows settings documented

primary.version: GOG Heroes of Might and Magic route with executable/engine state documented
primary.why: The first Heroes of Might and Magic is the series baseline. Current play is typically through GOG/legacy PC files, while exact DOS/Windows executable, fan-engine, and compatibility state should be documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current GOG/owned PC release. Record source, DOS or Windows executable, DOSBox/fix state, campaign/map, difficulty, faction, hotseat/multiplayer state, and whether later Heroes II/III entries were excluded.

secondary.why: PC is the strategy fidelity route.

all_releases.platform: GOG Heroes of Might and Magic route
all_releases.fidelity: Practical current PC route wrapping the original game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC executable, DOSBox/fix, and handheld adaptation states differ.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Heroes II, III, or later Complete editions.
